Husband Kills Wife in Ratlam; Neighbors Witness Attack

In Ratlam, a husband allegedly murdered his wife by slitting her throat. Neighbors who heard her screams arrived at the scene and witnessed the act. The husband was reportedly sitting on the victim's chest and attacking her with a knife. The incident occurred in Ratlam, with neighbors reportedly in shock upon seeing the scene.
